notes.title: Upcoming Playtest!
notes.content:
Commanders,
First, a heartfelt thank you to our Sherman Commander community for your patience and continued passion. We know the wait has been long, and we’ve heard your calls loud and clear.


We’re excited to announce that our upcoming playtest kicks off end of August/early September (a more precise date will follow)!  


This hands-on preview will feature: 

Tutorial Mission - Normandy
Get acquainted with the commander’s seat as you and your crew navigate the fields of Normandy Here, you will operate our titular tank with the interactive tutorial, both in Action and Simulation modes.

Demo Mission - Aachen
Put your skills to the test in an intense urban battle, coordinating your platoon in one of WWII’s most iconic city fights.



After completing the missions, we’d greatly appreciate it if you could share your thoughts via a short feedback survey. Your insights are vital in helping us refine and polish Sherman Commander so it can be the best version of itself!


Despite the silence of the recent months, the development still progresses according to plan, and we’re on track to launch the full version in 2026.

It would mean a lot to us, if you could use the Bug Report feature if any error occurs. This will be very helpful for us in catching potential issues.



In the meantime, don’t forget to add Sherman Commander to your Steam Wishlist - it’s the best way to stay updated and support the game.


See you on the battlefield,
The Sherman Commander Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 - Tank and more...
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=v0pWCWtqS9I;full][/previewyoutube]

Tank commanders!

Another Sherman Commander battlefield report. 
Work on the realistic reconstruction of vehicle models is still ongoing. This time we want to present German armored vehicles:

Panzer IIIJ
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/a19e18d8e80d350827ae542278f5efd78ad3ce3d.png

StuG III
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/b50e397942f6203194536940aa8c337a9a327a3f.png

Panther A
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/b850f0f0cf11280189e67a1fbd1998177181a350.png

Our goal is to recreate, in an as realistic way as possible, the combat conditions that commanders of Sherman tanks had to face.

We have implemented a 24-hour cycle and a dynamic change of lighting, which affects the range of observation and recognition of the battlefield.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/1bd1646e064548d1d776a71aa21699c1e9058945.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/9435cdb1af4ef853b25e551063081fce7cb54b33.png

The ability to destroy any object that is within the Sherman's armament range is one of the most important elements in the game.

Some passages are blocked by high walls or fences. There’s nothing that can stop you from destroying them and opening the way for infantry units:

[previewyoutube=vmp-hkbFNL0;full][/previewyoutube]

The number of shells in the tank is limited and not every target requires a cannon.
We can use the HMG mounted in the hull or the turret to destroy infantry units and smaller obstacles:

[previewyoutube=khXhVCmjCC4;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your unwavering support - we are eager to share our continued growth and achievements with you! 

Iron Wolf Studio - Sherman Team

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - The work is on!
notes.content:
Tank commanders!

Work on Sherman Commander is still going on and armored vehicles are one of the most important elements. 

We’re preparing realistic tank models and vehicles, and taking care of the mapping of original constructions. 

Here, take a look at a tank which you will be able to command: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/9749f7bee9525cb8015eae4a205d7c74cd0f2d7e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/e452cd0c8138f3d23d140b0cd832d57e82cd493b.png

Is there anything better than commanding a single tank? Well… Maybe leading an entire platoon on them?! In Sherman Commander you will be able to do that by giving orders to other tanks in your platoon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/4f6a88fbcf37023b260827893ada3b7f37625b44.png

Of course, there will be many other US Army vehicles besides Sherman Tanks! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/79953820e2cf39b537af996b49534b5186be265a.png

In addition to the visual side of the vehicles, we are dealing with mapping of their physics. There will be three types of tanks - light, medium, and heavy! Their sizes and weight impact combat and field operations. We want to simulate it as good as possible. 

At the same time, we are also working on objects from which the mission areas will be created. Destructibility tests for buildings are underway:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/6dfc95f9b67a118bd2455ca4e2b5e592fc25a053.gif

If you want to know who you will have to face in battle... Check out the first and very formidable opponent:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40365166/5c9beb1878263016f690f0f4a51c0028b761c791.png

Thank you and stay tuned for more materials from Sherman Commander! 

Take care! 
Sherman Team
